body.title: VOLUNTEER RELEASE AND WAIVER OF LIABILITY

body.p: Volunteer phone: {{volunteer_phone}}. I confirm I am 18 or older.
I understand that volunteer activities can involve physical work, travel and other risks, including injury and damage to property, and I take part voluntarily and assume those risks.
I release the organization, its officers, staff, volunteers and event partners from claims arising from my volunteering, except claims caused by their gross negligence or willful misconduct.
I authorize the organization to obtain emergency medical treatment for me if it reasonably believes I need it and I cannot consent, and I am responsible for its cost.
Photo consent: [[radio:Volunteer:Media consent:I consent to the organization using photos of me from the event|I do not consent to photos]]
If any part of this release is held unenforceable, the rest remains in effect.

name: Volunteer Release and Waiver of Liability
